title: Bo-Katan Kryze
description: Bo-Katan of Clan Kryze was a renowned Mandalorian Warrior from a legendary family. She wore beskar armor that had been in her family for generations. She led the Mandalorian resistance against the Empire, and guided her people through the age of Rebellion. Moff Gideon turned her planet into a wasteland and made an exile of her, leading Bo-Katan to hunt him down and work to restore her people to their rightful place on Mandalore. Her ultimate goal was to unite them once again under a single banner.
